description: This is a Java Spring Boot REST controller class, PaymentController, which provides endpoints for recording payments and payouts, as well as listing payments for a customer in an insurance management system.

classes.name: PaymentController
classes.description: REST controller providing endpoints for payment processing, including recording premium payments, claim payouts, and listing customer payments.

methods.name: premium
methods.description: Handles POST requests to record a premium payment for a customer policy, requiring authorization for roles CUSTOMER, AGENT, or ADMIN.

methods.name: payout
methods.description: Handles POST requests to record a claim payout, requiring authorization for roles AGENT or ADMIN.

methods.name: listForCustomer
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all payments associated with a specific customer, accessible by CUSTOMER, AGENT, or ADMIN roles.
